events.subject: Speculative application | Leather production, inspection and finishing | Mohammed Fadil
events.body:
Dear Ms Holler and Wollsdorf Recruitment Team,

I attempted to submit my application through your Austrian website form on 17 and 18 October, but each attempt returned a sending error and no application confirmation. I am therefore sending this speculative application to the recruitment address published in your official job notice.

Your careers page states that current vacancies are filled and welcomes unsolicited applications. I am applying speculatively for a suitable Austrian production, material-inspection or finishing function. I understand that an actual opening and worksite would need to be identified; I am not treating the historical semi-aniline specialist role as open.

Please find my CV, personalized cover letter and work portfolio with project photographs and certificate copies.

I am a Moroccan national resident in Morocco without Austrian residence or work authorization. My English and French are A2; German is A1, studying for A2. Could you consider applicants from Morocco for an appropriate Austrian role and support the necessary employer-side employment and residence process?

Please advise the role, location, weekly hours, gross pay and language requirements. I could start after the required authorizations and visa.

Kind regards,
Mohammed Fadil
+212 603 574 848
mfadil.med@gmail.com
